sections.Profile:
The "Phantom of the Opera" pinball machine, released by Data East in 1990, is inspired by the 1910 novel by Gaston Leroux. Designed by Joe Kaminkow and Ed Cebula, with artwork by Paul Faris, it features an atmospheric playfield with elements such as a Catwalk Ramp, Magic Mirror, Trap Door, and an Organ that opens for Multi-Ball. The game is known for its rich artwork and thematic music, contributing to an immersive gothic experience.
